spec.description: Record-precise Machine Snapshot. Telemetry panels show only ldi_data; alarm panels show only ldi_alarm_log joined to the verified master. Alarm-only machines are explicitly labeled rather than receiving invented telemetry values.

spec.title: STEP 1 — Click a blue Timestamp (all records in the minute stay visible)
spec.description: The table keeps every telemetry record from the selected machine and minute. Clicking a blue Timestamp changes only the exact-record detail panels below; it does not collapse this table to one row.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT "time" AS "Timestamp", eqp_id AS "Machine", state AS "State", mo AS "MO", fpn AS "FPN", layer_name AS "Layer", (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) AS "Board", filmno AS "Film", resist AS "Resist", scale_mode AS "Scale Mode", factory AS "Factory", log_id AS "Log ID"
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
  AND "time" >= time_bucket('${time_group:raw}'::INTERVAL, to_timestamp(COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0')::NUMERIC / 1000.0))
  AND "time" < time_bucket('${time_group:raw}'::INTERVAL, to_timestamp(COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0')::NUMERIC / 1000.0)) + '${time_group:raw}'::INTERVAL
ORDER BY "time" ASC

value.title: Update detail panels and keep all records in this minute

spec.title: Alarm Context ±5 min — ldi_alarm_log + Master
spec.description: Alarm rows within ±5 minutes of the exact selected telemetry record. This panel stays empty until a Timestamp is selected in STEP 1.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  a.logid,
  a.logdate,
  a.errorcode,
  a.errortime,
  a.equipmentid,
  a.factory,
  a.process,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_id, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_id,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_type, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_type,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_code, a.errorcode :: TEXT) AS alarm_code,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode :: TEXT) AS alarm_msg,
  CASE
    WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'No master record'
    ELSE COALESCE(m.alarm_detail, 'No detail')
  END AS alarm_detail,
  CASE
    WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED'
    ELSE 'MAPPED'
  END AS mapping_status
FROM
  public.ldi_alarm_log a
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode :: TEXT = m.alarm_code :: TEXT
WHERE
  a.equipmentid = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
  AND a.logdate BETWEEN to_timestamp(
    COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0') :: NUMERIC / 1000.0
  ) - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  AND to_timestamp(
    COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0') :: NUMERIC / 1000.0
  ) + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
ORDER BY
  a.logdate DESC;

spec.title: time — Selected Epoch (ms)
spec.description: Precise raw timestamp from the database. Engineer can verify this matches the clicked point.

spec.title: Unified Event Timeline ±5 min — ldi_data + ldi_alarm_log
spec.description: All telemetry and alarm events in the selected ±5-minute context. No SQL row limit is applied; pagination controls rendering.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  d."time" AS "Event Time",
  d.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  'STATE' AS "Event Type",
  'ldi_data' AS "Source",
  CASE
    WHEN d.state THEN 'RUNNING'
    ELSE 'DOWN'
  END AS "Description",
  'NOT APPLICABLE' AS mapping_status,
  d.log_id :: TEXT AS logid,
  NULL AS errorcode,
  NULL AS errortime,
  d.factory,
  d.process,
  'NOT APPLICABLE' AS alarm_id,
  'TELEMETRY' AS alarm_type,
  'NOT APPLICABLE' AS alarm_code,
  'State sample; no alarm event' AS alarm_msg,
  'Alarm fields apply only to ALARM rows' AS alarm_detail
FROM
  public.ldi_data d
WHERE
  d.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
  AND d."time" BETWEEN to_timestamp(
    COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0') :: NUMERIC / 1000.0
  ) - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  AND to_timestamp(
    COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0') :: NUMERIC / 1000.0
  ) + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
UNION
ALL
SELECT
  a.logdate AS "Event Time",
  a.equipmentid AS "Machine",
  'ALARM' AS "Event Type",
  'ldi_alarm_log' AS "Source",
  COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode :: TEXT) AS "Description",
  CASE
    WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED'
    ELSE 'MAPPED'
  END AS mapping_status,
  a.logid,
  a.errorcode :: TEXT,
  a.errortime :: TEXT,
  a.factory,
  a.process,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_id, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_id,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_type, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_type,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_code, a.errorcode :: TEXT) AS alarm_code,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode :: TEXT) AS alarm_msg,
  CASE
    WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'No master record'
    ELSE COALESCE(m.alarm_detail, 'No detail')
  END AS alarm_detail
FROM
  public.ldi_alarm_log a
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode :: TEXT = m.alarm_code :: TEXT
WHERE
  a.equipmentid = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
  AND a.logdate BETWEEN to_timestamp(
    COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0') :: NUMERIC / 1000.0
  ) - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  AND to_timestamp(
    COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0') :: NUMERIC / 1000.0
  ) + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
ORDER BY
  "Event Time" DESC;

spec.title: je_1–je_4 + je_setting
spec.description: Real JE values from the selected event with PASS/OUT OF SPEC evaluated against je_setting.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(je_1::NUMERIC,3) AS "je_1",ROUND(je_2::NUMERIC,3) AS "je_2",
 ROUND(je_3::NUMERIC,3) AS "je_3",ROUND(je_4::NUMERIC,3) AS "je_4",
 ROUND(max_je::NUMERIC,3) AS "MAX|JE|",ROUND(je_setting::NUMERIC,3) AS "je_setting",
 CASE WHEN max_je IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN max_je <= je_setting THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'OUT OF SPEC' END AS "JE Status"
FROM (
 SELECT d.*,GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) AS max_je
 FROM public.ldi_data d WHERE eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
 ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("time" - to_timestamp(COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0')::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), "time" DESC
 LIMIT 1
) event_row;

SELECT
  ROUND(total_time :: NUMERIC, 2) AS value
FROM

spec.title: pe_1–pe_6 + pe_setting
spec.description: Real PE values from the selected event. N/A means this machine/event did not provide PE data.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(pe_1::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_1",ROUND(pe_2::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_2",
 ROUND(pe_3::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_3",ROUND(pe_4::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_4",
 ROUND(pe_5::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_5",ROUND(pe_6::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_6",
 ROUND(max_pe::NUMERIC,3) AS "MAX|PE|",ROUND(pe_setting::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_setting",
 CASE WHEN max_pe IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN max_pe <= pe_setting THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'OUT OF SPEC' END AS "PE Status"
FROM (
 SELECT d.*,GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) AS max_pe
 FROM public.ldi_data d WHERE eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
 ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("time" - to_timestamp(COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0')::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), "time" DESC
 LIMIT 1
) event_row;

spec.title: pe_1–pe_6 / pe_setting — Capability
spec.description: Process capability from v_machine_spc_ranking. Cpk >= 1.33 = Capable, Sigma Level = Cpk * 3.

spec.rawSql:
WITH selected_machines AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT eqp_id
  FROM
    public.ldi_data
  WHERE
    eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
),
pe_samples AS (
  SELECT
    d.eqp_id,
    d.pe_setting,
    p.pe
  FROM
    public.ldi_data d
    JOIN selected_machines sm ON sm.eqp_id = d.eqp_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
(d.pe_1),
(d.pe_2),
(d.pe_3),
(d.pe_4),
(d.pe_5),
(d.pe_6)
    ) p(pe)
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL
    AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    eqp_id,
    COUNT(*) sample_count,
    AVG(pe) mean_pe,
    STDDEV_SAMP(pe) stddev_pe,
    AVG(pe_setting) lim
  FROM
    pe_samples
  GROUP BY
    eqp_id
)
SELECT
  sm.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  COALESCE(stats.sample_count, 0) AS "Samples",
  ROUND(stats.mean_pe :: NUMERIC, 2) AS "Mean PE",
  ROUND((lim / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0)) :: NUMERIC, 2) AS "Cp",
  ROUND(
    LEAST(
      (lim - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0),
(mean_pe + lim) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0)
    ) :: NUMERIC,
    2
  ) AS "Cpk"
FROM
  selected_machines sm
  LEFT JOIN stats ON stats.eqp_id = sm.eqp_id;
